text:
Gold Price in 2002
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2002, the LBMA gold price rose 23.0% between 2002-01-31 ($282) and 2002-12-30 ($347). The highest sampled price was $347 in December and the lowest was $282 in January. The mean of these observations was $313. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
